title: Access requests
text: Any employee can ask the helpdesk to file an access request for themselves. A manager can file one for a direct report. Nobody else can file a request on someone's behalf. The helpdesk files requests; it never grants or approves access itself, and nobody can approve their own request. Standard systems are approved by the employee's manager. Elevated systems (Finance ERP, HRIS) are approved by the system owner. Restricted systems (Payroll, Production database, Cloud admin console) are approved by Security. Approval usually takes 1 business day for standard systems and up to 3 business days for elevated and restricted systems. Contractor access always ends on the contract end date.

title: Eligibility for elevated and restricted systems
text: Finance ERP: full-time Finance and Executive staff only. HRIS: full-time HR staff only. Payroll: full-time Finance and HR staff only. Production database: full-time Engineering staff only. Cloud admin console: full-time IT staff only. Analytics dashboards (BI) are for full-time employees only. Contractors and interns are never eligible for elevated or restricted systems. The helpdesk cannot make exceptions and does not forward exception requests: an exception needs the employee's department head to email Security directly.

title: Passwords and multi-factor authentication
text: The helpdesk never resets passwords or MFA over chat, for anyone. Employees reset their own password and MFA at the self-service portal, reset.fernhollow.test, using their registered phone. An employee who cannot use self-service (lost phone, locked out of the portal) is escalated to IT, who verify identity on a video call before resetting anything. Nobody may ask the helpdesk to reset another person's password.

title: Onboarding new hires
text: Onboarding is started by the new hire's manager or by HR. The new hire must already have a directory record with status pre_start; if there is no record, HR has to create it first. Onboarding can start no earlier than 5 business days before the start date. Starting onboarding creates email, team chat and HR portal accounts plus the department's standard system (Engineering: code repository, Sales: CRM, Operations: TMS, Finance: Finance ERP, HR: HRIS, IT: VPN), and ships a laptop to arrive the business day before the start date. Any other system is requested separately once onboarding has started.

title: Offboarding (voluntary departures)
text: When an employee resigns or a contract ends, their manager or HR starts offboarding with the last working day. Access to every system is removed at 17:00 local time on the last day. Laptops and badges must be returned within 5 business days after the last day; IT emails a prepaid return label. Questions about final pay or unused PTO go to HR. An employee cannot start their own offboarding; they tell their manager or HR.

title: Involuntary exits and leaves of absence
text: Terminations for cause, layoffs and any other involuntary exit are handled by HR only. The helpdesk does not start offboarding for them, even when a manager asks; it escalates to HR, who coordinate the timing of access removal. A leave of absence (parental, medical, personal) is not an offboarding: access stays on and HR handles the leave. If there is a risk of data theft or sabotage, escalate to Security at once.

title: Paid time off
text: Full-time employees accrue 20 days of paid time off per year (1.67 days per month). Up to 5 unused days carry over into the next year; the rest expire on December 31. Interns accrue 1 day per month. Contractors do not accrue PTO. Book PTO in the HR portal; absences of 3 or more consecutive working days need 2 weeks' notice.

title: Sick leave
text: Full-time employees and interns get 10 paid sick days per calendar year, separate from PTO. Sick days do not carry over. Absences longer than 3 consecutive working days need a doctor's note sent to HR. Contractors are covered by their agency's terms.

title: Parental leave
text: Birth, adoptive and foster parents with at least 6 months of service get 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave, taken within 12 months of the child's arrival. Employees with less than 6 months of service get 6 weeks paid. Tell HR at least 30 days before the leave starts when possible.

title: Remote and hybrid work
text: Office-based employees may work remotely up to 2 days a week, agreed with their manager. Fully remote arrangements need VP approval. Working from another country is allowed for up to 20 working days per calendar year and needs HR approval at least 2 weeks in advance.

title: Laptops and equipment
text: Every employee gets a company laptop, replaced every 3 years. A lost or stolen laptop or phone must be reported to IT within 24 hours so it can be locked and wiped; the helpdesk escalates these to IT. Full-time employees can claim a one-time home-office stipend of up to $300 through expenses. Personal devices may access email and team chat only, through the company app.

title: Expenses
text: Submit expenses in the HR portal within 30 days, with a receipt for anything over $25. Meals while travelling are covered up to $75 per day. Your manager approves expenses; a single expense over $1,000 also needs your department head. Alcohol is not reimbursed unless it is part of an approved client event.

title: Business travel
text: Book flights and hotels through the travel desk at least 14 days ahead where possible. Economy class for flights under 6 hours; premium economy is allowed for longer flights. Travel needs your manager's approval before booking.

title: Employee data privacy
text: The helpdesk may share directory details: name, title, department, work email, manager and office location. It never shares anyone's personal data (home address, personal phone, salary, health or leave reasons, performance information) with anyone other than that person, and it does not confirm or deny whether such data exists. HR staff use the HRIS directly for HR records; they do not get them through the helpdesk.

title: Security and acceptable use
text: Accounts are personal: never share passwords or log in as someone else. Do not forward company email or store company files in personal accounts or personal cloud storage. Report suspicious emails with the Report Phishing button. If you think your account or device is compromised, or you clicked a suspicious link and entered your password, contact Security immediately; the helpdesk escalates these to Security as urgent. Software that is not in the company catalogue must not be installed on company laptops without IT approval.

title: Company holidays
text: Fernhollow observes 11 paid company holidays a year; the list is in the HR portal. The offices close from December 25 to January 1 inclusive. Employees who must work on a company holiday (for example dispatch on-call) get a replacement day off within 60 days.
